bullets.label: Cost
bullets.text: 2 SPI

bullets.label: Duration
bullets.text: 1 hour, or until the ward is broken

bullets.label: Effect
bullets.text: All divination attempts against you are at -2 while the ward holds

bullets.label: Bonus
bullets.text: You gain +2 on detection rolls (see Sec. 2 above) while warding is active

bullets.label: Limitation
bullets.text: Ward breaks if you suffer injury greater than HP/3 (round down) from a single attack

bullets.label: Cost
bullets.text: 2 SPI

bullets.label: Duration
bullets.text: 1 hour

bullets.label: Effect
bullets.text: All divination against you is at -4

bullets.label: Bonus
bullets.text: Anyone trying to recall specific details about you must first win a Quick Contest of Will vs your SPI

bullets.label: Extension
bullets.text: You may extend Concealment to one willing target within touch range at +1 SPI per additional target

bullets.label: Cost
bullets.text: 2 SPI

bullets.label: Duration
bullets.text: 1 hour, or until the Faceless changes their masked identity

bullets.label: Effect
bullets.text: Any divination attempting to identify you or locate you by your spiritual signature diverts to the person you are impersonating

bullets.label: Limitation
bullets.text: You must have met or studied the target whose aura you mimic. A simple description is not enough — you need 10+ minutes of close observation or a personal item.

bullets.label: Counter
bullets.text: A diviner who critically succeeds on their Divination Arts or Ritualistic Magic roll realises the spiritual signature is a mask and may attempt a Quick Contest of Divination Arts or Ritualistic Magic vs your SPI to pierce it

bullets.label: Cost
bullets.text: 3 SPI

bullets.label: Duration
bullets.text: Instant (opposes a single divination attempt)

bullets.label: Effect
bullets.text: On a successful SPI roll, the divination is redirected to a random location or person within 1 mile

bullets.label: Deception
bullets.text: The diviner does not know their spell was misdirected unless they critically succeed

bullets.label: Limitation
bullets.text: Does not work against diviners 2+ Sequences stronger than you

entries.name: Historical Mimicry: Spiritual Blank
entries.availability: Fool Pathway, Seq 3 — Scholar of Yore

bullets.label: Cost
bullets.text: 5 SPI

bullets.label: Duration
bullets.text: 1d6 minutes (the projection collapses immediately if you take any hostile action)

bullets.label: Effect
bullets.text: Any divination targeting you returns information about the projected historical figure or scene instead of you

bullets.label: Penalty
bullets.text: Concentrating to maintain the projection prevents you from taking other complex actions

bullets.label: Detection
bullets.text: A demigod of equal or stronger Sequence can perceive the projection as a 'laminated' spiritual layer and may attempt a Quick Contest of Divination Arts or Ritualistic Magic vs your SPI to see through it

bullets.label: Cost
bullets.text: SPI equal to what a divination of that scope would normally cost (see Chapter 6.5, Section III, or Chapter 7, Power Sources)

bullets.label: Duration
bullets.text: 24 hours, or until you perform a new self-divination that overwrites the previous one

bullets.label: Effect
bullets.text: The external diviner receives a false but plausible result — the echo of your self-divination

bullets.label: Deception
bullets.text: The diviner does not know the result is false unless they critically succeed
